exposure: Early closure of abdominal wall defect (<= 5 days after birth)
Delayed closure of abdominal wall defect (> 5 days after birth)
cohort: The study included 109 infants with gastroschisis who were managed using primary silo with staged reduction.
finding: Delayed closure of the abdominal wall defect and complex gastroschisis were associated with a longer time to reach full feeds and a longer duration of hospital stay.
